capacity_requirements_summary: Sustained throughput target 300 reqs/s with burst to 1200 reqs/s during peak windows. Typical request profile: 80% short-context chat (<=256 tokens), 15% reranking batches (up to 64 items), 5% long-form summarization. Desired latency SLOs: P95 <= 120ms (chat), P95 <= 200ms (reranking). Planning target: reserved GPU pool sized for 90% of peak sustained traffic with autoscale headroom for burst capacity. Prefer multi-GPU partitions to isolate reranking from chat workloads.
autoscaling_policies_summary: Preferred scale-up behavior: horizontal add of pre-warmed replicas from warm pool with target fill time <= 30s; fallback vertical scaling only for non-latency-critical batch reranks. Scale-down: conservative cooldown 10–15 minutes to avoid thrash during small traffic dips. Warm pools: maintain 10% of max pool as pre-warmed GPUs (configurable by time-of-day), with 'market-open' schedule to pre-warm before known spikes. Queueing behavior: soft-queue with SLA-aware prioritization (chat higher priority than rerank), queue depth threshold metrics trigger scaling policies and circuit-breaker when queue latency > SLO. Request draining policy on scale-down to preserve KV cache for conversational sessions.

Sales & legal aligning on revised language; Redwood exploring operational mitigations (regional warm pools + cross-region standby) to reduce RTO.
